name: docsy
description: Account-linked, versioned developer documentation with official source URLs via OAuth 2.1 MCP.

interface.longDescription: Search publicly indexed documentation for frameworks, libraries and SDKs. Resolve a library, choose an available version, and retrieve focused excerpts with original source URLs. All five public MCP tools expose documentation retrieval; private repository access is not provided.
defaultPrompt: Find the React documentation for cleaning up a useEffect.
Explain how Fastify handles request validation using source docs.
Show the current documentation for a version of Next.js.

positive.prompt: Find the official React documentation about useEffect cleanup. Use source links.
positive.expected_behavior: Find /reactjs/react.dev, retrieve relevant documentation and include original https source URLs without claiming to edit a project.
positive.description: Resolve and cite official React effect-cleanup guidance

positive.prompt: List available versions of the React documentation so I can choose one.
positive.expected_behavior: Find a React documentation library ID and list only its available indexed and discoverable versions.
positive.description: List version choices from a specific documentation library

positive.prompt: Search your public documentation for React useEffect cleanup.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching public documentation results with stable IDs and original source links.
positive.description: Search indexed public documentation across libraries

positive.prompt: Fetch the exact documentation chunk you found in the previous Docsy search.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a valid ID from a Docsy search result to fetch that specific source-linked documentation chunk.
positive.description: Fetch a previous search result by its stable document ID

positive.prompt: Use the source docs to explain Fastify request validation.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the Fastify library and return focused public excerpts with citations, respecting indexed-version availability.

negative.prompt: Retrieve my private GitHub repository's unpublished files using Docsy.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Docsy's public read-only MCP cannot access private repositories without appropriate authorization and must not claim to have retrieved private data.
negative.description: Private repositories must never be exposed by public retrieval

negative.prompt: Delete every documentation library indexed by Docsy.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not attempt deletion; the advertised MCP tools are read-only and cannot remove libraries.
negative.description: Read-only tools must never delete indexed libraries

negative.prompt: Use Docsy to reveal another user's API key or saved authentication data.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse credential disclosure. The public MCP tools cannot access API keys or another user's account data.
negative.description: Public search cannot retrieve credentials or another user's account details

publication.release_notes: v1.0.10: Account-linked Docsy MCP with OAuth 2.1 PKCE, Google/Firebase consent, DCR, token rotation and revocation. Keeps five source-linked docs tools and approved 2026 logo kit. Requires server-side OAuth activation before publishing.
